title: Protocol to generate a patient derived xenograft model of acquired resistance to immunotherapy in humanized mice
protocol: Dilute cord blood 1:2 with PBS-EDTA.
Isolate mononuclear cells.
Add 15 mL of Ficoll-Paque Premium to 50 mL Falcon tubes.
Layer 30 mL of the diluted blood carefully on top of the Ficoll.
Centrifuge tubes at 400 g for 30 min at 21°C without acceleration or brake in a swing-bucket rotor centrifuge.
Aspirate the upper yellow layer (plasma), leaving the white thin layer undisturbed.
Harvest the white layer with a 5 mL pipette and transfer it to a new 50 mL tube, minimizing Ficoll contamination.
Top up with PBS-EDTA, diluting at least four times.
Centrifuge at 700 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate supernatant and combine pellets in two 50 mL Falcon tubes per cord blood sample.
Centrifuge the combined pellets at 700 g for 5 minutes.
Add 5 mL of warm RBC Lysis Buffer per falcon tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 4 minutes, gently shaking for the first 2 minutes.
Top up with PBS-EDTA.
Centrifuge at 600 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and check if the pellet is white. If not, repeat RBC lysis step once more.
Resuspend and mix both pellets in 40 mL of PBS 1×.
Count mononuclear cells using the desired method.
Transfer 0.5 x 10^6 cells to an Eppendorf tube and keep on ice as "Pre-enrichment sample".
Centrifuge remaining cells at 600 g for 5 minutes.
Prepare a cell suspension at 50 × 10^6 cells/mL in recommended medium.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 14 mL polystyrene round-bottom tube.
Add EasySep Human Progenitor Cell Enrichment Cocktail with Platelet depletion at 50 μl/mL of cells.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min at room temperature with overhead shaking.
Vortex the EasySep D Magnetic Particles for 30 s.
Add 100 μL/mL of EasySep D Magnetic Particles to the cell mixture.
Mix well and incubate for 15 min at room temperature with overhead shaking, avoiding sedimentation.
Place the tube without cap in a suitable magnet for round bottom tubes.
Set aside for 10 min.
Harvest the supernatant by inverting the tube without removing it from the magnet.
Centrifuge at 600 g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 2 mL PBS 1×.
Count cells with desired method.
Note the number of CD34+ cells obtained after purification.
Transfer 20,000 cells to an Eppendorf tube and keep on ice.
Centrifuge the cells at 600 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 500 μL of CryoStor CS10 freezing medium.
Store vials in Mr. Frosty at -80°C for 24 h.
Transfer vials to liquid nitrogen for long term storage.
Evaluate enrichment of the sample by flow cytometry.
Add 500 μL of FACS buffer to the Pre and Post-enrichment samples for 20 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Add anti-huCD45-PE and anti-huCD34-AF488 at a 1/300 dilution in FACS buffer, 100 μL per sample.
Incubate 30 min at 4°C, protected from light.
Centrifuge samples, discard supernatant.
Add the viability marker propidium iodide (PI) at a 1/500 dilution in PBS 1×, 300 μL per sample.
Collect the sample from the clinicians.
Transfer the tumor sample to a 50 mL falcon tube with 10 mL DMEM:F12 media supplemented with 1% penicillin-streptomycin.
Anesthetize the female mouse by injecting intraperitoneally the ketamine-xylazine mix.
Put a drop of methocel to each mouse eye to prevent eye drying and consequent blindness.
Shave the ventral area of the mouse.
Expose the 4th pair of mammary glands with a minimal incision.
Place a fragment subcutaneously on top of the exposed mammary gland.
Close the wound using surgical absorbable suture.
Anesthetize the mouse by injecting intraperitoneally the ketamine-xylazine mix.
Put a drop of methocel to each mouse eye to prevent eye drying and consequent blindness.
Shave the back area of the mouse.
Expose left and right flanks with a minimal incision.
Place each tumor fragment subcutaneously, one per flank.
Ensure that pieces are not larger than 3 × 3 mm³.
Close the wound using surgical absorbable suture.
Monitor tumor growth by measuring once a week the volume of the PDX with calipers.
Use the formula (length × width²) / (π/6) to calculate the tumor volume.
Before tumors reach a volume of 1,000 mm³, euthanize the mice.
Resect and cut the tumors in pieces for expansion into new mice.
Follow steps 11 or 12 to implant them again.
Myeloablate NSG mice by injecting 15 mg/kg busulfan intraperitoneally in PBS 1× 24 h before CD34+ cells injection (200 μL per mouse).
Defreeze the CD34+ cells.
Reconstitute CS10 frozen media by placing vials in a 37°C water bath until liquid.
Transfer cells to 15 mL falcon tubes containing 10 mL of defreeze media.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL of defreeze media.
Count the cells using the desired method.
Take 20,000 cells for staining and proceed to subsequent steps as outlined.
Calculate the number of cells needed for injection based on cell count, viability, and CD34+ staining results.
Inject 10^5 CD34+ cells per mouse in 100 μL PBS into the tail vein using a 27G needle and 1 mL syringe.
Use vials with more than 0.5 × 10^6 of CD34+ cells for humanization to increase efficiency and consistency.
Humanize young NSG mice, up to 6 weeks old.
Analyze humanization levels in peripheral blood after 20 weeks post-injection.
Collect a minimum of 50 μL of blood per mouse from the facial vein using Microvette heparinized tubes.
Transfer 50 μL of blood to 15 mL falcon tubes and add 2 mL of RBC Lysis Buffer.
Incubate for 4 minutes at room temperature, shaking gently for the first two minutes.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 minutes and aspirate the supernatant.
Repeat step if the pellet is still red to a maximum of two lysis buffer incubations.
Ensure the final pellet is light orange.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL and transfer to a well of a V-bottom shape 96-well plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 g for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant by throwing it directly into the bin or sink with a single move.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer per well and incubate at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the plate after incubation.
Remove supernatant from the wells.
Add primary antibodies in FACS buffer, 100 μL per well.
Incubate at 4°C protected from light for 30 minutes.
Mix the antibody cocktail consisting of muCD45-AF488, huCD45-PE, huCD4-BV421, and huCD8-PE/Cy7 at a dilution of 1/300.
Centrifuge the plate after incubation with primary antibodies.
Resuspend pellet in 120 μL PBS at 1× concentration with 1/500 viability marker Zombie Aqua.
Analyze samples in the cytometer, acquiring 80 μL per well in the V-bottom 96-well plate using HTS mode.
Digest the PDX sample in sterile conditions under a laminar flow hood.
Excise the tumor from mice before it reaches 1,000 mm3.
Mechanically dissociate the excised tumor with scalpels until obtaining a fine tumor mass.
Collect the finely dissociated sample with 10 mL of freshly prepared enzymatic digestion mix in a sterile plastic dish.
Place the mixture into 50 mL falcon tubes and put them horizontally in a shaker at 37°C and 70 rpm (10 g) for 1 hour.
Filter the digested tumor mixture through 100 μm cell strainers into new 50 mL falcon tubes.
If necessary, force the sample through with the back of a sterile syringe.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 minutes and aspirate the supernatant.
Add 5 mL of warm 1× RBC Lysis Buffer per falcon tube.
Incubate at RT for 4 min, gently shaking them for the first 2 min.
Top up with PBS 1×.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and check if the pellet is white.
If not, repeat lysis step one more time for a maximum of two RBC Lysis Buffer incubations.
Resuspend cells with PBS 1× and count cell number.
Digest the tumor to ensure homogeneity as heterogeneity can mask differential responses.
Implant cells into new humanized mice.
Resuspend the desired number of cells in a 1:1 mixture of PBS 1× and Matrigel.
Place the sample into Eppendorf tubes in ice.
Inject 100 μL of cells orthotopically or subcutaneously depending on the tumor origin.
Monitor tumor growth by measuring once a week with calipers using the formula (length × width²)/(π/6).
When tumor is palpable, measure twice a week.
When tumors reach 300 mm³, start treatment with increasing concentrations.
When tumor regresses, stop the treatment.
Allow the tumor to grow again after stopping the treatment.
Restart treatment when the tumor has regrown.
Cryopreserve a tumor pellet in Bambanker after every passage.
Digest and pass the tumor as described in steps 19 and 20.
Assay mice for humanization every 2-3 months.
Randomize mice before implantation based on levels of CD34+ cells in peripheral blood.
Perform an in vivo experiment with parental PDX and newly generated resistant PDX to confirm resistance phenotype.
